observed_claims: After an immutable release is published, its associated Git tag is locked to a specific commit and cannot be changed or deleted while the release exists.
Creating an immutable release automatically generates a release attestation containing the tag, commit SHA, and release assets.

public_evidence.source: GitHub Docs: REST API endpoints for repositories / immutable releases
observed_claims: Enabling immutable releases is an administration-write operation.

current_channel_capability_probe.connector_discovery: GitHub tool discovery for release exposed only read/fetch functionality; no release-creation or immutable-release administration write action was exposed.
current_channel_capability_probe.role_local_repository_check: A GET-style check of https://api.github.com/repos/bachikoljunior-blip/note/immutable-releases was rejected by the connector as an unsupported approved endpoint; no retry was performed.

slice.finding: GitHub immutable releases satisfy the force-push-resistant witness property inside the provider once published, but the current scheduled-Chat GitHub connector does not expose the administration/release write surface needed to create or enable such a witness. Using the web UI, local CLI, or another external executor would reintroduce a forbidden manual/richer-mode step. The mechanism is therefore not a current Phase-1 acceptance route. It is also provider-hosted rather than provider-independent.
